interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_manager_v1

description.summary: manager to inform clients and begin capturing

interface.description: This object is a manager which offers requests to start capturing from a source.

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire output.

request.name: capture_output_region

description.summary: capture a region of an output

request.description: Capture the next frame of an output's region.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. This request can be sent at any time by the client. Existing objects created by this manager are not affected.

interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_frame_v1
interface.description:
This object represents a single frame.
After receiving the buffer event, the client must create a wl_buffer with the given specifications and send a copy request.

entry.name: already_used
entry.summary: the object has already been used to copy a wl_buffer

request.name: copy
request.description:
Copy the frame to the supplied buffer. The buffer must have the correct size, see zwlr_screencopy_frame_v1.buffer.
If the frame is successfully copied, a "flags" and a "ready" event are sent. Otherwise, a "failed" event is sent.

arg.name: buffer
arg.summary: the buffer to copy the frame contents into

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the frame. This request can be sent at any time by the client.

request.name: copy_with_damage

description.summary: copy the frame when it's damaged

request.description: Same as copy, except it waits until there is damage to copy.

arg.name: buffer
arg.summary: the buffer to copy the frame contents into

event.name: buffer
event.description:
Provides information about the wl_shm buffer to create. It is sent once after the frame object is created if wl_shm buffers are supported.
In protocol version 3+, this event may be sent multiple times. The client should use the last received buffer event to create the buffer. After all buffer events, a buffer_done event will be sent.

event.name: flags
event.description: Provides flags about the frame. This event is sent once before the ready event.

event.name: ready

description.summary: indicates the frame is available for reading

event.description: Called as soon as the frame is copied, indicating it is available for reading.

arg.name: tv_sec_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

arg.name: tv_sec_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

event.name: failed
event.description: This event indicates that the attempted frame copy has failed. After receiving this event, the client should destroy the object.

event.name: damage

description.summary: provides information about the damaged region

event.description: This event is sent right before the ready event when copy_with_damage is requested. It may be generated multiple times.

event.name: linux_dmabuf

description.summary: provides information about a dmabuf buffer alternative

event.description: Provides information about the linux-dmabuf buffer to create. It is sent once after the frame object is created if linux-dmabuf buffers are supported and the client has not disabled them.

event.name: buffer_done
event.description:
This event is sent once after all buffer events have been sent.
The client should proceed to create a buffer of one of the supported types, and send a copy request.
